description.en: The business tenant code. The default value is ALICOM\_OPAAS.

description.zh:
组件分组Code。取值：

- Messaging：消息类组件。

- Core：核心组件。

- Intelligence：智能组件。

- Contact：联系人管理组件。
description.en:
The code for the component group. Valid values:

- Messaging: Message components.

- Core: Core components.

- Intelligence: Intelligence components.

- Contact: Contact management components.

description.zh: 搜索关键字。即为根据流程组件名称模糊查询。
description.en: The search keyword. This parameter is used to perform a fuzzy query by flow component name.
The number of entries per page.

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口查询流程组件原型，也可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面查看流程组件原型。

- 此接口中的非必填参数为流程组件原型的筛选条件，若不填写，则查询全部的流程组件原型。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this API operation to query flow component prototypes. You can also view the prototypes on the orchestration canvas in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) by clicking a flow name.

- You can use the optional parameters for this operation to filter flow component prototypes. If you do not specify any optional parameters, all flow component prototypes are returned.
